answer_1.quote: To prompt the GPT-2 and GPT-D models to generate text we utilized Bird et al.'s synthetic "Cookie Theft" picture description narrative... Both GPT-2 and GPT-D generate ∼10 OOV token on average for each prompt.
answer_1.outputs: Generated textual narratives used for analysis of lexical frequency and repetitiveness

answer_2.quote: We investigated whether GPT-D generates content of higher lexical frequency than the GPT-2 model... Log lexical frequency of each qualified generated token was calculated... To assess the degree of repetition present in the generated text, we calculated the type-to-token ratio (TTR).
